title: A KB-Work or Self-Reviewed line outside the trailer block passes the commit and the push unread
goal: check-trailers, run by sync --push and the pre-push hook, refuses a commit of the pushed range whose message holds a KB-* or Self-Reviewed line that git does not read as a trailer (in a paragraph above the last one), naming the commit and the line, and the commit-msg hook warns of it at commit time, so no such commit reaches main again; pushed history is never rewritten. Found by intake: 13 commits on main had an unread KB-Work line, and on 2026-10-07 an unread Self-Reviewed line made land stop at step stale (SP-eahtellz).

run:
import subprocess,sys,tempfile;from pathlib import Path;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import kg_trailers as k;t=Path(tempfile.mkdtemp());g=lambda *a:subprocess.run(['git','-c','user.name=t','-c','user.email=t@corp.example.com','-c','commit.gpgsign=false',*a],cwd=t,check=True,capture_output=True,text=True).stdout;g('init','-q');(t/'notes.txt').write_text('x
',encoding='utf-8');g('add','notes.txt');g('commit','-q','--no-verify','-m','chore: planted

KB-Work: BG-aaaaaaaa
Self-Reviewed: kb/_self/git.md

Co-Authored-By: Jan Kowalski <jan.kowalski@corp.example.com>');k.KB=str(t);a=k.trailer_audit(g('rev-parse','HEAD').strip(),quiet=True);out='
'.join(ln for _,ls in a[2] for ln in ls);print(out or 'check-trailers passes the planted commit');sys.exit(0 if 'KB-Work: BG-aaaaaaaa' in out and 'Self-Reviewed: kb/_self/git.md' in out else 1)

notes: a KB-Work line git does not read as a trailer (a blank line before Co-Authored-By?): 03412dee03, 178087d30b, 27901ee5a7, 3c8cf8bdd5, 4b4e17be61, 7219acbb56, 744ea615bc, 8da30157b3, 9cb820ecb3, a4c6373d20, ac03d1b3fa, b5765e22b9, e468ddb4dd; changes _tools/, .claude/, .githooks/ or .gitlab-ci.yml with no KB-Work or KB-Auto trailer: 39f643b18e, 5a2a45778e, 5c3bfd0ea7, 9286c5e81c, 9fc143f3b1, ad70d90965, b8c95fccdd, d7a88846d7, e4537efc12, fc795c8e1f, ffe1273a0c Triaged 2026-10-07 by the operator: reshaped from the intake finding to prevention.
